scripts.setup: cd back-end && npm install && cd ../front-end && npm install && cd ../mac-app && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 20.10.0 && npm install && cd node_modules/better-sqlite3 && npx node-gyp rebuild --target=28.3.3 --arch=arm64 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && cd ../.. && cd ../agents && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd .. && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/back-end/.env" back-end/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/agents/.env" agents/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/front-end/.env" front-end/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/research/.env" research/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/mac-app/.env" mac-app/.env
scripts.run: (cd back-end && rm -f backend-logs.log && npx tsx watch src/server.ts 2>&1 | tee backend-logs.log) & (cd front-end && rm -f frontend-logs.log && npx vite 2>&1 | tee frontend-logs.log) & (cd agents && source venv/bin/activate && ./scripts/run_local_worker.sh) & wait
